requirement.statement: The .NET OM SHALL provide a NamedQuery registry and execution API backed by Portable Datalog and CozoScript compilation.

case.given: A NamedQuery with Portable Datalog source, relation mappings, parameter schema, and table result shape
case.when: The query is executed with valid parameters
case.then: The system SHALL parse, validate, compile, execute through ICozoOmStore, and return table rows with diagnostics
The system SHALL return structured diagnostics and SHALL NOT execute partial CozoScript
